prompt:
Image 1: a Q-style super-deformed chibi medieval revenant about as wide as it is tall - one big round head in a tattered rust-crimson monk's cowl with two big glowing pale eyes and a tiny wicked grin in a black void, short stubby arms in ragged sleeves with chunky clawed hands held out to the sides, and a short tattered robe hem tapering to a floating point with no legs or feet. Thick dark ink outline, flat cel shading, upper-left key light, fixed three-quarter top-down view, transparent background.

Instruction: Draw ONE horizontal sprite strip of this EXACT same creature, showing three animation frames in a single row, left to right, evenly spaced, all three the SAME height, the SAME width, the SAME chibi proportions, the SAME camera angle, hovering on the SAME invisible baseline, with WIDE COMPLETELY EMPTY vertical gaps between them. The three figures must NOT touch or overlap each other anywhere.

It has no legs, so this is a hover cycle, not a walk. Frame 1 (left): neutral hover, exactly like Image 1. Frame 2 (middle): the stubby arms swung UP and outward, the tattered hem streaming to one side, the body bounced slightly taller. Frame 3 (right): the stubby arms swung DOWN and inward, the hem streaming to the other side, the body squashed slightly shorter and wider.

Keep identical: the rust-crimson and blackened-brown cloth, the bone-white trim, the glowing eyes, the thick ink outline weight, the flat cel shading, the single upper-left key light, and the transparent background. No ground, no shadows, no frame borders, no numbers, no labels, no text.

Image 1: a Q-style super-deformed chibi knight - a chunky squat armoured man-at-arms with a big round barrel body in overlapping dull scorched steel plates with brass rivets and brass trim, a faded crimson surcoat with a heraldic device, a small rounded great helm with a dark visor slit sunk between two enormous rounded steel pauldrons, huge chunky gauntlets, and two very short stubby legs in steel greaves with big flat sabatons. Thick dark ink outline, flat cel shading, upper-left key light, fixed three-quarter top-down view, transparent background.

Instruction: Draw ONE horizontal sprite strip of this EXACT same creature, showing a three-frame heavy waddle walk cycle in a single row, left to right, evenly spaced, all three the SAME height, the SAME width, the SAME chibi proportions, the SAME camera angle, standing on the SAME invisible baseline, with WIDE COMPLETELY EMPTY vertical gaps between them. The three figures must NOT touch or overlap each other anywhere - leave a clear empty gap at least half a character wide between one figure's edge and the next, including between their pauldrons and gauntlets.

Frame 1 (left): neutral contact pose, both feet planted wide, exactly like Image 1. Frame 2 (middle): mid-step with the LEFT stubby leg lifted and swung forward, the body rolling onto the right leg, the whole body tilted and bounced slightly taller. Frame 3 (right): mid-step with the RIGHT stubby leg lifted and swung forward, the body rolling onto the left leg, tilted the other way and squashed slightly shorter and wider.

Keep identical: the scorched steel plate, the brass rivets and trim, the faded crimson surcoat, the great helm, the enormous pauldrons, the thick ink outline weight, the flat cel shading, the single upper-left key light, and the transparent background. No ground, no shadows, no frame borders, no numbers, no labels, no text.
